svg.title: As-built feather templates - 42 feathers, 1:1 mm, vertical flip
svg.desc: Aggregate of as-built/vectors/individuals/*.svg, one group per feather prefix. Each outline is copied verbatim from its individual file and only translated and mirrored (vertical) about its own centre, so it stays 1:1 (user units = mm) and keeps its label. Each feather's geometry now lives once in <defs> as a vertical definition (id + "-def"); the <use> that places it carries only the rotation the arrangement needs.
